openers.learn_button_location: On the side of the motor unit, next to the LED.

remote: Find the yellow Learn button on the side of the motor unit.
Press and release the Learn button. The LED next to it stays lit for about 30 seconds.
Within 30 seconds, press and hold the remote button you want to use.
Let go when the opener lights blink or you hear two clicks.
Press the remote button again to check the door moves.
keypad: Press and release the Learn button on the motor unit.
Within 30 seconds, type a 4-digit PIN of your choice on the keypad.
Press and hold Enter until the opener lights blink.
Test it: type your PIN and press Enter.
erase: Press and hold the Learn button for about 6 seconds, until the LED goes out.
All remotes and keypads are now erased. Program the ones you want to keep again.

steps: Hold your garage remote 1 to 3 inches from the HomeLink buttons on the mirror or overhead console.
Press and hold the HomeLink button you want to use and the remote button together.
Let go when the HomeLink light changes from a slow to a fast flash.
For a rolling-code opener, press the Learn button on the opener, then within 30 seconds press and hold the HomeLink button for 2 seconds. Repeat up to three times until the door moves.
cars.rolling_code_note: Most openers made since 1997 use rolling codes and need the Learn button step.
